          SIPAJHAR COLLEGE
                   MESSAGE
  FROM THE PRINCIPAL'S DESK


          As the Principal of Sipajhar College, I feel happy to welcome you all to this vibrant higher
educational institution. Sipajhar College is one of the prestigious institutions of the district located in
Sipajhar, the cultural capital of Darrang. Established in 1971, our institution has proudly crossed its golden
jubilee – 50 years of excellence in education and character building. We are honoured to mention here that
Sipajhar College was the ﬁrst higher educational institution in the entire district to earn an esteemed NAAC
accreditation with B++ grade in 2023 in its 3rd cycle of assessment and accreditation – a testament to our
commitment to quality. Over these decades, Sipajhar College has nurtured countless students across two
vivid streams: Arts and Science in UG level alongside PG courses in Assamese and English subjects. As we
step into this new session, we are thrilled to introduce a cutting-edge Integrated Teacher Training Course
(ITEP) with dual BA/BEd degree course under Gauhati University approved by NCTE, paving new paths for
career growth.
         We are also embracing the transformative power of the National Education Policy-2020. This policy
is designed to broaden horizons with multidisciplinary learning, skill-based education, employability
opportunity and enhanced ﬂexibility. At Sipajhar College, we are integrating NEP-2020 into our curriculum to
ensure students develop not just academic prowess but also critical thinking, creativity, and a global
outlook- expanding their opportunities in a dynamic world. Furthermore, to provide maximum exposure to
our students the college family endeavoured to promote both national and international seminars,
workshops, lecture programmes inviting national and international scholarly ﬁgures from different ﬁelds,
exposure visits etc. The college authority is trying hard to provide continuously modern facilities to our
students through one of the ﬁnest Central Library in the district along with departmental libraries, digital
conference hall, smart classrooms, indoor stadium, up-to-date laboratories, etc.
         Our students thrive not just academically but also through a rich array of co-curricular opportunities.
We have dynamic societies- like “Uddipana”, society for child education where students voluntarily learn to
engage in nation building process; “Cultural Society” to cater the needs of rich cultural heritage; “Literary
Society” to enrich the literary base of the students and “Competitive Society” to nurture and boost up the
career aspirations of young and energetic minds. For our dedicated faculties, we have one “Research
Society” to foster innovation as well as to create an environment for inquisitive mind of research in the
region. Alongside, we offer Computer Courses and various add-on programmes, ensuring that our students
stay ahead in a rapidly evolving world.
         We take immense pride in our energetic and knowledgeable faculty members, who are dedicated to
student success in all discipline. Nestled in a picturesque campus, Sipajhar College is a beacon of
knowledge, culture and holistic development. We invite you to be part of our legacy and let us march
together towards a new horizon. We are committed to give one new ﬂy to your talent with our effort.
                                                 Thank you.
                                                                   Dr. Satyendra Kumar Sarmah

                           OUR VISION, OUR MISSION

Vision :
The College was established with the vision of making quality education accessible to the
economically disadvantaged student community of the greater Sipajhar area. It aspires to nurture
and promote the potential of its students to the fullest extent.


Mission:
* To empower socially, economic all and educationally marginalized sections of the rural society of
the region.
* To make the students knowledgeable, cultured & responsible citizens.
* To cultivate national integrity, social awareness, scientiﬁc attitude, and self-esteem among the
 rural students through appropriate education.


                                       College Emblem




       The ofﬁcial emblem of Sipajhar College reﬂects the institution's commitment to knowledge,
excellence, and holistic development. The logo prominently features a circular design enclosed by
laurel leaves, symbolizing honor, achievement, and academic success. At the center, the imagery
of an open book and a rising sun represents the pursuit of knowledge, enlightenment, and
continuous progress.
       The name of the institution is inscribed within the emblem, along with its year of
establishment, 1971, signifying its long-standing contribution to higher education. The use of
Assamese language in the logo highlights the college's cultural roots and regional identity.
Overall, the emblem embodies the core values of Sipajhar College—education, wisdom, integrity,
and societal advancement.

standard boards and councils. The combination of subjects and the compulsory subjects offered at the

 III. Post Graduate Course (M.A) in Assamese and English
      The college offers master degree programmes in Assamese and English under the afﬁliation
of Gauhati University. The M.A. programme in Assamese was introduced in the academic session
2015–2016, whereas the M.A. programme in English was introduced subsequently in the
academic session 2024–2025.
The sanctioned intake capacity for the M.A. programme in Assamese is 20 (twenty) students,
while that for the M.A. programme in English is 30 (thirty) students. Each programme is of two
years' duration, structured into four semesters in accordance with the prevailing academic
regulations of the University.

Rules and Regulations of the Library


Ÿ All members have to record their name, address and time of arrival and departure and put their

Ÿ Disruptive behavior, such as creating loud noise, loud talking, screaming, or banging on

Ÿ Consuming food or beverages inside the library is strictly prohibited.
Ÿ Each student is allowed to borrow two books at a time.
Ÿ Books are issued to students for a period of One month. They may be reissued for another 15

    Students can avail the computer facility for utilizing the e-resources only.
Ÿ Books on loan with members can be recalled at any time, without assigning any reason thereof.

 Student Aid Fund
          The College has an aid fund for economically weaker students. However, since the number of such
students is very high, ﬁnancial assistance to be provided to all such students is not possible. Hence the
college has set up a Book Bank which provides books to the needy students (In addition to the ones they are
entitled to borrow from the Central Library)

Students' Union
         The Students' Union of the college is a constitutionally elected body with a tenure of one year. It is
entrusted with activities related to the interests and welfare of the students. The Union has its own ofﬁce
room and plays a proactive role in the affairs of the college. It is responsible for organizing the Annual All
Assam Debate Competition, College Week, and Freshmen Social, as well as coordinating participation in
university youth festivals, inter-college volleyball competitions, football competitions, and other events. The
college authority extends full assistance and cooperation to the Students' Union in carrying out its activities.

Uniform
The prescribed uniform of the college is as follows:
For Girls: Coffee-coloured salwar and dupatta with a beige-coloured kurta bearing the college logo, along
with a coffee-coloured sweater carrying the college logo.
For Boys: Coffee-coloured trousers and a beige-coloured shirt bearing the college logo, along with a coffee-
coloured sweater carrying the college logo.

National Service Scheme (NSS)
         Established in 1993 to inculcate social consciousness and a sense of responsibility, discipline and
dignity of labor among the youth the National Service Scheme (NSS) is a voluntary organization of college
students under the Union Ministry of Human Resource Development. Students can enroll themselves in the
NSS unit of the college at the beginning of the academic session. The college unit of the NSS takes up a
number of social service programs with active participation of the people of the locality, social service
programs with active participation of the people of the locality.

Bharat Scouts and Guides
         The Unit of Bharat Scouts and Guides was constituted at Sipajhar College in 2009. Since then, it
has been rendering a fruitful service to the college participating in all its auspicious occasions. Besides, the
unit also involves itself in different occasions and activities arranged by the State as well as the Central
Government.

Students' Identity Card
          The college identity card is issued to the students at the time of admission. The duly ﬁlled in identity
card authenticated by the signature of the Principal of the college is to be carried by all students. In case of
any loss or damage to the card, the matter should be immediately reported to the Principal and a duplicate
will be issued on payment of the prescribed fee.




                                                                       Prospectus // Sipajhar College // 23
 Students' Travelling Concession
        Students of the college are entitled to concessions on travel home and back during vacation,
for travelling on academic tours organised by the college and for travel in connection with college
activities.


Co-Curricular Activities
Games and Sports: The college has a well-equipped Indoor Sports Training Centre constructed
with UGC assistance under the XI Plan. It provides facilities for indoor games such as Badminton
and Table Tennis, including a synthetic badminton court. The college also has a walled playground
with a gallery for outdoor games like Football, Volleyball, and Cricket. In addition, a gymnasium with
essential ﬁtness equipment is available for physical exercise and training. These facilities
encourage students to participate actively in sports and maintain physical ﬁtness.
Yoga: To aware about Yoga among our students, a class of Yoga and meditation is included in the
regular class routine. For such, our college have a Yoga and Meditation room for the students.
These classes are conducted by trained yoga experts.
College Magazine: A college magazine is published in the open Meeting of the College week
every year to provide avenues for the expression of the literary talents of its students and is a useful
record of all important college activities. Wall magazines are also brought out by all the
departments of the college annually and by the Students' Union twice a year.


Girl's Hostel
A full-ﬂedged Women's Hostel having all modern amenities has been functioning for the last
decade and offer accommodation for girls. It has a seat capacity of 60 and the students are allotted
seats on the basis of merit. However, women coming from remote places with inadequate transport
and communication facilities are given priority. A separate form for admission to the hostel can be
obtained from the hostel warden on the day of college admission. It is to be ﬁlled and submitted to
the warden at the time of admission.


Rules and Regulations For Boarders of the Girl's Hostel


1.   Boarders must pay their monthly mess dues on time.
2.   No Border is allowed to leave the hostel without prior permission from the hostel
     Superintendent.
3.   Visitors are allowed to meet a border only during visiting hours and in the visiting room.
4.   All hostel property like furniture, utensils, electrical appliances etc should be treated properly
     and in the event of any damage the matter should be brought to the notice of the
     superintendent immediately.
5.   Use of unauthorized electrical appliances such as heaters and irons are strictly prohibited.


                                                                 Prospectus // Sipajhar College // 24
 6.   Expulsion from the college hostel implies expulsion from the college and vice versa.
7.   The hostel remains closed during all vacations.
8.   A student may stay as a hostel guest during examinations, with prior permission from the
     hostel superintendent. Such a guest can stay for not more than a month and she will have to
     pay Rs 200 as seat rent to the college.
9.   Any student staying in the hostel for more than a month will be treated as a regular boarder.


Information cum Career Guidance and Counselling Cell (ICGC)
       This is a student welfare service aimed at providing the students with guidance and
counseling to cope with personal and social problems and to provide wide exposure to career
opportunities. Through workshops, seminars, individual counseling sessions, and access to
relevant literature and online resources, the cell empowers students to make well-informed
decisions about their educational and career pursuits.

                 INTERNAL QUALITY ASSURANCE CELL (IQAC)
The IQAC (Internal Quality Assurance Cell) of Sipajhar College takes responsibilities to organize different
events according to academic and event Calander, give enough exposure to students by organizing events
as well as student and faculty development initiatives like organizing seminar, conference, workshop,
training and ﬁeld visits. IQAC also takes up initiative to implement the UGC recommended Performance
Based Self Appraisal System. The IQAC of the college has taken up the preparation of Teaching Plan, Unit
Test Schedule, Annual Plan etc. as per UGC / NAAC recommendation. Activities of different clubs and
societies are also monitored by IQAC and time to time academic and administrative audit (AAA) is being
conducted with proper documentation. The IQAC has made a provision for taking online feed-back from the
students of the college on various aspects of teaching and learning. The feed-back is analyzed and report
made known to the teachers. Maroi Bijuli-Bari village has been adopted by the IQAC of the college and
another 4 villages have also been adopted from last year under Unnat Bharat Abhiyan of Govt. of India. The
IQAC takes the responsibility to plan and prepare futuristic college development plans to cope up with the
changing socio-academic development for improved academic as well as holistic development of the
region.


                            FORUM, CLUBS AND SOCIETIES

SCIENCE FORUM
Sipajhar College Science Forum (SCSF) has been fully functioning from the year 2020 for service to the
people. The forum believes in scientiﬁc temper to transform society by utilizing technological advantages as
the integral part of life. The mission of SCSF is to build up new generations conﬁdent enough with scientiﬁc
temper to nurture their talent for contributing towards the superstition free and scientiﬁcally literate society.
Every year “National Science Day” is organized by SCFC.
ECO CLUB
The Eco Club of Sipajhar College was established on 2018. It plays a vital role in creating environmental
awareness amongst students and public in the vicinity. The objective of the club is to maintain an eco-
friendly lifestyle in the society at large scale. The club also encourages 'Green Initiatives' by educating the
entire college about pollution and environmental hazards through human activities and measures to
minimize it. Various talks, awareness programs, plantation drives are undertaken by the Eco Club to
emphasize and encourage the need to go green for a healthier and better world.
COLLEGE ENVIRONMENT AND CLIMATE CELL (CECC)
The 'College Environment and Climate Cell' has been established in 2020 in Sipajhar College. This Cell is
funded and sanctioned by Assam Science Technology and Environment Council (Department of Science
and Technology, Govt. of Assam). This Cell aims in creating awareness on environment related issues and
adopts around 10 High Schools and Higher Secondary Schools every year in its locality.



                                                                       Prospectus // Sipajhar College // 31
 WOMEN'S CELL
The college has a Women's Cell which functions under the aegis of the ACTA. The Cell regularly
arranges health camps, workshops and lectures on women's health issues by leading health
practitioners. The Cell is actively involved in observing World Literacy Day and International
Women's Day. Various women related awareness programs are organized by the cell in the nearby
villages.
BOOK CLUB
It is a literary forum constituted with an executive body. It is a forum where readers can come
together and talk about books and the reading experiences. It is a group of people who meet in a
regular interval, to discuss a book or books that they have read and express their opinions, likes,
dislikes, etc. This club can also involve in other social activities for the all-round development of its
members as well as for the society.
RED RIBBON CLUB
The Red Ribbon Club at Sipajhar College is a youth-led initiative aimed at spreading awareness
about HIV/AIDS, health, and social responsibility among students. It works under the guidance of
the National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) and promotes safe and healthy lifestyles among
students.
COMPETITIVE SOCIETY
Sipajhar College Competitive Examination Society (SCCES) has been formed in October, 2025.
The society was formed with a view to encourage the interested students of the college for
appearing in different state and central level competitive examinations. The society provides study
materials, periodical seminars, talk by resource persons, mock test etc. along with regular study
facility in ofﬂine and online mode.
LITERARY SOCIETY
The Sipajhar College Literary Society has been formed in November, 2025. It is dedicated to
cultivating a vibrant, inclusive environment that encourages the students to engage deeply with
diverse forms of literature, develop their critical reading and writing skills, and share their creative
work in a supportive and constructive setting. The Society aims to be the preeminent hub for literary
exploration, creative expression, and intellectual discourse within the community, fostering a
lifelong skill in the written world and nurturing the next generation of readers, writers, and critical
thinkers
UDDIPANA
A Committee under the Chairmanship of the Principal named “Social Service Society for Child
Education, Sipajhar College” with the title “Uddipana” was formed in September, 2025. The
purpose of forming the society is to provide a platform for students and staff to engage in social
service activities and specially focused on education of underprivileged children of the society.




                                                                  Prospectus // Sipajhar College // 32
 RESEARCH SOCIETY
The Sipajhar College Research Society, established in October 2025, aims to cultivate a strong
research culture within the institution. During the academic year 2025–26, it reached a notable
milestone by approving six research proposals submitted by faculty members of Sipajhar College,
thereby encouraging academic inquiry, innovation, and the overall development of institutional
research.
CULTURAL SOCIETY
A society by the name Sipajhar College Cultural Society has been formed to convert the campus
into a vibrant, holistic space where students will grow beyond academics. Personal development,
cultural enrichment and community building of the learners are the main objectives of the society.
The society nurture students' creative and aesthetic sensibilities through by involving them in
activities like music, dance, drama, ﬁne arts, etc. The society will work for promoting conﬁdence,
public-speaking skills, stage presence, etc of the learners by organizing performances and
competitions from time to time.
